name: okkama-rust-champ
description: Rust implementation: Champ execution (champ-abi build, OKKAMA_PIPELINE=oir2).
notes: Builds okkama-cli with --features champ-abi and the gate profile (release optimizations without LTO) into .target/engine-champ/gate (never shared with the Sparrow build). parse/check go to the native endpoint (shared front end); run/test go through `okkama run` on Champ. Compare with a run of adapter.json on the same profile: tools/champ_blockers.py.
